interpretation.likely_cause: The evidence points to the current table-width-patched DOCX causing LibreOffice's export worker to fail before finalizing a nonempty PDF, while the soffice.exe launcher/log still reports return code 0.
evidence: The failed packaged run and current-DOCX direct probe both used the required bundled LibreOffice absolute path.
Current-DOCX logs report export success but the expected PDF is absent; the direct probe left a PDF lock and zero-byte temp plus a LibreOffice crash dump.
The older prefinal DOCX converted successfully through the same bundled executable to a 228-page PDF.
The stderr text 'Could not find platform independent libraries <prefix>' appears in earlier successful conversions too, so it does not distinguish this failure.
interpretation.unresolved: The crash dump metadata provides version/build and hardware facts but no stack trace; exact failing OOXML element is not established by this environment-only inspection.

suggestions: Treat this as a DOCX-specific LibreOffice export failure rather than switching to the user's desktop LibreOffice or reinstalling the renderer.

Correlate the failure against the two table-width patches by checking their OOXML width/grid/cell-width consistency; if needed, isolate one patch at a time using disposable copies, then use the bundled executable and a fresh unique profile/output directory.
Only restart full rendering and prepare new QA pins after a nonempty final PDF is actually present and its page count matches the new PNG set.
